maya: quick update from the onboard run for orion-12b-int6. short summary and routing recs for GTN.
liam: drop the top-level numbers pls.
maya: numbers: cost per 1k tokens ~0.53x vs fp16 on conversational slice using int6-profile-C. throughput improved on short turns (<128 tokens).
maya: tradeoff: p95 latency for long-context (>=2048 tokens) increased about 170ms due to dequant overhead and KV miss amplification.
eval-bot: [auto-report] model=orion-12b-int6 | p50=62ms | p95=210ms | token-cost=0.53x | rougeL_delta=-0.55 | accept_rate=0.915
anika: product wants safety thresholds before GTN.
maya: quality: regression mostly on structured numeric outputs and long-coherence summarization. on short QA slices difference is negligible (~0.1 BLEU). examples: FP16: "Amount due: $12,450.00" INT6: "Amount due: 12,450 dollars" — subtle format regressions that break parsers.
joel: do we see hallucination uptick?
maya: not on factual slices. main issue is tokenization and punctuation shifts.
liam: routing idea?
maya: propose hybrid routing policy:
- short-turns (<150 tokens or <6 turns): route to orion-12b-int6
- long documents/summaries: route to fp16 variant
- realtime fallback: if region p95 > 350ms, fallback to fp16
liam: recommended canary split?
anika: product proposes cautious approach: start 3% traffic, inside that 90/10 int6/int16, step to 20% with 75/25 after 72h if no regressions.
maya: additional config: bump KV prefetch TTL from 30s to 180s for the canary sessions; in testbed this reduced p95 by ~50ms. also offloaded dequant path to worker threads in PR #4599—please backport to dedicated fleet.
joel: rollout checklist?
maya: checklist:
1) add orion-12b-int6 to catalog with tags int6, hybrid
2) create route_policy: "hybrid-int6-short-orion"
3) canary: 3% traffic with inner split 90/10
4) enable kv_prefetch_ttl override for canary
5) monitor slices: numeric-format failures, p95 latency, accept_rate
6) abort if accept_rate < 0.9 or rougeL drop > 1.0
liam: monitoring to add in console?
maya: yes: route token-cost by p50/p95, per-slice quality eval every 2h, kv hit ratio by session length, sample diffs for structured parse failures.
anika: messaging for GTN?
liam: say "cost-optimized short-turns with hybrid routing; long docs handled by higher-fidelity tier." include numbers: ~47% token cost reduction for chat-workloads.
maya: I'll prepare the GTN blurb. includes: baseline fp16=1.0x cost, int6=0.53x for short-turns, expected short-turn quality delta ~0.1 BLEU/ROUGE, longform delta ~0.55 ROUGE-L. recommended pilot: 3% traffic, 90/10 inner split; rollback triggers: accept_rate <90%, p95 increase >150ms vs baseline, rougeL drop >1.0.
liam: perfect. thx maya. I'll attach bench logs to the ticket.
maya: ping QA for a small golden eval run. :thumbsup:
